item.title: Spring 2027 Study Abroad Application Now Open!
item.description: The application for spring 2027 study abroad is now open. Undergraduates can log into the study abroad application portal with their RCS ID and password. Visit the Education Abroad website for details: https://isss.rpi.edu/education-abroad. Questions? Contact Karen Dvorak, Education Abroad Program Manager, dvorak2@rpi.edu.

item.title: RPI at Work Information Session
item.description: Date: Wednesday, July 29, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:30 PM - RPI at Work will be reviewing the online, project-based graduate degrees and certificates. Expect to hear details about how RPI Instructor Mentors provide industry expertise, advice, and mentorship in a targeted and experiential learning environment. Please register if you plan to attend and learn more about RPI at Work.

item.title: Fidelity Confidential Consultation (By Phone with Zoom Video Option)
item.description:
Date: Thursday, July 30, 2026 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM - Schedule a confidential consultation to help you become better informed and more confident about your workplace retirement savings plan benefits. To schedule an appointment, call 1-800-642-7131, Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to midnight, or online at https://nb.fidelity.com/public/nbpreloginnav/rpi/microsite/#/tem/meet-with-us
